provenance.exact_claim_text: A multi-component supplement improves immune outcomes.

evidence.text: The measured immune biomarker showed no statistically significant improvement versus control.
Self-reported illness duration was shorter in the intervention arm (a materially relevant favorable difference).

findings.proposition: An unqualified global immune-improvement claim is not established; the study's evidence is mixed.
findings.verdict_summary: Mixed evidence: a null measured biomarker (E1) alongside a favorable self-reported outcome (E2). Does not support an unqualified global improvement claim.

client_findings.display_claim: The immune-improvement claim is not directly established; the study's results are mixed.
client_findings.client_explanation: One measured immune marker showed no significant change; a self-reported outcome was favorable. Overall the evidence is mixed and does not support an unqualified improvement claim.
